name: Bjørn Arnesen
bio:
Bjørn's career began not in motorsport, but in the structured environment of a large Oslo-based engineering firm. He spent years honing his skills in personnel management and conflict resolution before a lifelong passion for racing drew him to the EVO Racing Team. He saw an opportunity to bring his methodical approach to a field often perceived as chaotic. 

At EVO, Bjørn is known for his meticulous attention to detail when it comes to contracts and employee relations. He believes in fostering a fair and transparent work environment, ensuring everyone on the team feels valued and supported. While some might find his insistence on following procedure rigid, his colleagues appreciate his dedication to preventing issues before they arise. His background gives him a unique perspective on the blend of technical skill and teamwork required for success in motorsport.

 Bjørn is also known for his love of cross-country skiing, often spending weekends traversing the Norwegian wilderness, finding solace and clarity in the solitude. He believes this allows him to bring a refreshed and focused mindset to his HR duties during the week.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly combed back with a slight wave
physical.description: Bjørn is a moderately tall man with a sturdy build and a perpetually serious expression.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook to jot down observations about team dynamics.
Insists on using a specific brand of Norwegian coffee beans in the office.
Has a collection of vintage motorsport posters displayed in his office, meticulously arranged by year.
